sections.manifest: Schema type validation. Body HTTP message, query URL, params path, headers request, cookie browser. Each with object schema. Type inferred automatically. When schema provided always validate.
Guard schema multiple handlers. Override default replaces schema. Standalone co-exists separate. Guard parameters: schema, beforeHandle, response. How to use guard?
Body HTTP message validation. POST with JSON body. Form-data file uploads. t.Object for properties. Required by default. GET/HEAD body disabled.
File upload. t.File single file with format, minSize, maxSize. t.Files multiple files array. Multipart form-data automatic. Standard Schema with fileType magic number validation.
Query string URL parameters. ?key=value format. Coercion for Number to Numeric. Array format: nuqs with comma, HTML multiple with repeated key. How to use query validation?
Headers request metadata. Lower-case keys only. AdditionalProperties true by default. Authorization header example.
Cookie browser data. t.Cookie or t.Object. AdditionalProperties true. Cookie attributes management.
Response validation. Return value type check. Status-specific responses. Multiple status codes.

Error messages custom. Error property on schema. Error function for programmatic messages. ValidationError from elysia/error. Validator TypeCheck. Error.all list all errors. VALIDATION code for validation errors.
Custom error messages. Error string or function. Type parameter errors, type, validation, value. Error called per field only if invalid.
Reference model .model() method. Named models with auto-completion. Multiple models. Namespace naming convention. Reusable schema definitions.
